output.summary: An evergreen succulent considered native to the southeastern Arabian Peninsula, aloe vera has thick, fleshy, serrated leaves and spreads through offsets. Some varieties have white-flecked leaves, and yellow tubular flowers appear on a tall summer spike.
output.edibilityNote: The gel is used in yogurts, beverages and desserts; high or prolonged doses of latex or whole-leaf extract can be toxic.
